test.name: paper, container, spacing, margin, radius, and primitive rules are structural

citations.catches: A statically declared Paper nested inside another Paper in governed component and feature source.
citations.misses: It does not prove that every route has exactly one Paper or resolve dynamic wrappers.

citations.catches: The integrated specimen has one Paper, compositing Containers, distinct Canvas and Paper, and no nested Paper.
citations.misses: A passing specimen does not prove every product route uses the same roles.

review.instruction: Review each route composition for exactly one shell-owned Paper and no Card-as-layout substitution.

citations.catches: Human review can judge whether a route assigns the semantic surface roles correctly.
citations.misses: There is no global static rule requiring exactly one Paper per route.

test.name: status colour is ink rather than a sixth surface role

citations.catches: Invalid surface markers such as treating status as a structural surface.
citations.misses: It cannot infer whether arbitrary painted content semantically represents status.

citations.catches: The rendered status treatments use governed ink and compositing Container treatments with alpha below one.
citations.misses: It does not assert the dark story or judge whether a product chose the correct consequence level.

citations.catches: The representative stream row renders the governed title and functional-metadata sizes.
citations.misses: It does not scan the product for every misuse of tertiary type.

review.instruction: Review subtitles, alerts, actions, and mobile-critical facts for forbidden tertiary sizing.

citations.catches: Review can judge whether information importance matches its assigned type role.
citations.misses: No scanner currently enforces the semantic 16/14/12 role assignment product-wide.

test.name: paper, container, spacing, margin, radius, and primitive rules are structural

citations.catches: Literal margin utilities added by callers to governed components.
citations.misses: It does not decide whether an ordinary parent gap matches the intended semantic density.

test.name: paper, container, spacing, margin, radius, and primitive rules are structural

citations.catches: Annotated macro spacing placed outside an outer layout zone.
citations.misses: The rule depends on the author declaring the macro tier and does not infer visual rhythm.

review.instruction: Review tight, compact, standard, and generous relationships in the rendered product context.

citations.catches: Review can judge whether spacing expresses the intended relationship.
citations.misses: No mechanical mapping exists between every gap utility and the four semantic densities.

test.name: paper, container, spacing, margin, radius, and primitive rules are structural

citations.catches: Off-ladder literal radius utilities in governed JSX class strings.
citations.misses: Named radii hidden behind helpers, variants, or dynamic class composition can evade the scan.

test.name: radius enforcement rejects named off-ladder values and non-concentric painted nesting

citations.catches: A directly nested painted surface whose static outer radius is smaller than its inner radius plus uniform inset.
citations.misses: It does not resolve asymmetric, dynamic, or deeper geometry and does not judge role appropriateness.

review.instruction: Review large, medium, small, and full radii against the semantic role of the rendered object.

citations.catches: Review can distinguish a true pill or independent raised surface from decorative rounding.
citations.misses: No scanner can infer the semantic object class from radius alone.

test.name: paper, container, spacing, margin, radius, and primitive rules are structural

citations.catches: Literal margin utilities added by callers to governed components, with the redline probe making the same violation visible at runtime.
citations.misses: The scanner does not resolve dynamic classes, and one rendered probe does not prove every caller boundary is margin-free.

citations.catches: The production sidebar, Paper, TopBar, route viewport, safe-area ownership, and their live keylines remain geometrically connected.
citations.misses: A deterministic shell specimen does not prove every product route preserves the same anatomy.

citations.catches: The candidate bottom navigation stays outside Paper, reserves the mobile Canvas band, and exposes four non-overlapping 44-to-48-pixel rendered targets.
citations.misses: The story does not emulate every coarse-pointer engine or authorize mounting the candidate navigation in PlatformShell.
